Unity Game Developer — 3+ Years Experience
Taptik Studio is looking for an experienced Unity Game Developer to join our team and work on exciting mobile and casual games.
What We're Looking For
- Strong experience with Unity and C#
- Excellent understanding of Unity's game development workflow and architecture
- Strong knowledge of Unity Animation System: Animator Controller, Animation Clips, Blend Trees, Avatar/Mecanim, Animation Events, IK, Timeline
- Strong knowledge of Shaders and Materials: Shader Graph, HLSL/Shader programming, Custom shaders, VFX and visual effects, URP, Post-processing
- Experience with Unity UI / Canvas / TextMeshPro
- Strong understanding of 3D physics, colliders, rigidbodies and raycasting
- Experience with particle systems and VFX
- Good understanding of lighting, rendering and optimization
- Experience optimizing games for Android/iOS
- Understanding of mobile performance optimization: CPU/GPU optimization, Draw calls, Batching, Memory optimization, Object pooling, Profiling
- Experience with Git/version control
- Ability to write clean, scalable and maintainable C# code
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
Good to Have
- Experience with DOTween
- Experience with Unity Addressables
- Experience with Unity Asset Bundles
- Experience with Firebase / GameAnalytics
- Experience integrating SDKs and third-party plugins
- Experience publishing games to Google Play / App Store
- Experience working on hyper-casual, casual, puzzle, arcade or mobile games
- Knowledge of procedural generation
- Experience creating or optimizing custom rendering solutions
- Experience with AI-assisted game development tools
Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain high-quality Unity games.
- Implement gameplay mechanics, UI, animations, VFX and game systems.
- Create and integrate custom shaders and visual effects.
- Optimize games for mobile devices.
- Debug and resolve technical and performance issues.
- Work closely with designers and artists to bring game concepts to life.
- Build reusable and scalable gameplay systems.
- Participate in prototyping and rapid game development.
- Prepare builds and help with testing and publishing.
